question: Select the synonym of **Loathe**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Loathe"** means to feel intense dislike or disgust for something or someone. (घृणा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She loathes waking up early on weekends.
 
 
 
• **"Hate"** refers to a strong feeling of dislike or aversion toward someone or something. It is a synonym of "loathe." (नफरत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He hates being stuck in traffic for hours.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "Hate" is the correct synonym for "Loathe."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): To agree to take or receive something willingly.

 
 
• **Example:** She accepted the job offer with enthusiasm.
 
 
 
• **Like** (पसंद करना): To find something agreeable or enjoyable.
 
 
• **Example:** I like listening to music in my free time.
 
 
 
• **Love** (प्यार करना): A deep affection or strong liking for someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** They love spending time together as a family.
 
 

142:Ta13,

The correct answer is **option 1.**</p&
